polishes.name: An Upside Down World
polishes.description: This Peel Off Base Coat helps you peel your way from one look to another as often as you change your outfit. It forms a smooth, clear and protective base for your nail polish and helps you peel away extreme colours and stubborn glitter in just one go. Causes no mess, no fuss and protects your nails from staining. PAINT. PEEL. REPEAT.
